items.title: Christian McBride interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: And then after meeting Wynton I met his brother Branford

ctx.x: Keep you on the right track.

Exactly. And then after meeting Wynton I met his brother Branford and I met Bobby Watson. I had a chance to meet a lot of great musicians as they came through Philadelphia to do different workshops. There was an annual workshop that goes on, a jazz festival rather that goes on in Philadelphia every year, sponsored by Mellon Bank, the Mellon Jazz Festival. And every year before they have the big gala concert they have all of the players come and do workshops for the high school students. So I had a chance to meet…
Did you start out on acoustic?
